## Problem and use case

What quality-management problem does this solve? Describe the affected users
and workflow rather than only the desired YAML shape.

## Proposed approach

Describe the proposed behavior and show a minimal example when useful.

## Alternatives considered

Explain whether existing resources or extensions can model the use case.

## Interoperability impact

State which specification, schema, documentation, examples, tests, or public
proposal details would need to change. Material semantic changes require a
public proposal; see
`CONTRIBUTING.md`.
